title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_11528)
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard specifies the dimensions and characteristics of 16 mm motion-picture film projection reels with nominal flange diameters of 7, 10, 13 and 18 cm. ♦Rules for rounding off numerical values ( revised), 3 IS : 11528 - 1985

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
